message: 天使の吐息

name: Synn
message: 「The shopping district's getting into the Christmas mood too~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Too bad the Demon Lord doesn't even have a single lover to spend Christmas with, huh? That's rough.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want to hear that from you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sorry 'bout that. I've got Ria-chan, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」
Oh? Listening intently in the middle of town is...

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina~~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ah, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you doing in a place like this.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I was exploring the shopping district. When I did, I found myself captivated by this lively music.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's such a lovely melody...」
Saying that, Amyrina closed her eyes once more.

name: Synn
message: 「It's like this every year when Christmas rolls around.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Is that so~~」

name: Synn
message: 「In your hometown, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「In Heaven, there isn't even such a thing as Christmas--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Wha-wa-wait.\s01」
Well, since she's Lolotte's childhood friend, I already have a rough idea of the situation, though.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey there, Synn-kun~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oops, Amyrina-chan? Hello~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-Hello... You're... Sacchin-san, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep, yep.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not with Nanaka today?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She's a dutiful daughter, that Nana-chan.」
Ah, helping out at the shop today, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「You should be filial to your parents too, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If I do that, Papa and Mama will pay me back double~ Gotta keep it in moderation~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So instead, I've decided to be a dutiful friend~」
Saying that, what she pulled out was a single ticket.

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's a voucher for two free hours of karaoke~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Kara-OK!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talking about being a dutiful friend--you just wanted something in exchange for the soba.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What a wicked little panda you are~ Not that I'm denying it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anyway, how about we go do some karaoke together~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「My heart's pounding...... I'd love to go......」

name: Synn
message: 「Should we invite Lolotte too?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte said she had some business with Azel and went out.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...... Well, it's a bit of an unusual lineup, but shall the three of us go!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ Can't wait~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So...... the after-party is at Yuugiri-an, huh.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, the usual~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good grief\s10 Coming right up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since Emi-chan's here today too, it's on the house for everyone!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay!」

name: Paqy
message: 「How generous!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Th-Thank you very much.」
'Thank you very much, Pops'
'Aw, don't mention it'

name: Sacchin
message: 「Man, still, that really surprised me~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At how tone-deaf Paqy is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What was that, hey!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Amyrina-chan is really good at singing, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, is that right.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No, that's not true...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus she's a fast learner, so she can sing songs she doesn't even know right away. It's amazing.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-Now even you, Mr. President...\s03」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah, I wanna hear her sing again.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You're the one with a wonderful singing voice, Sacchin-san...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Really? Thanks.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You know so many songs, don't you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, despite how I look, I'm just a normal girl.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'd love to learn all sorts of other songs too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think the day would come when Sacchin actually teaches someone something...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's mean, Nana-chan.\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got some karaoke tapes at my place that Tame-san gave me, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tapes.\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That sounds very intriguing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then stop by my place on the way home. I'll lend them to you.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nice going, Synn-kun. Being so bold it's even making Nana-chan panicky.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like that\s01 Right, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm so excited... I can't wait...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「She's not even listening.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「It's probably cold outside, so wait inside. I'll go look for it right away.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Simon!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I haven't even said anything yet!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「E-E-Excuse me for intruding...」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'll go make some tea.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um... at times like this, I believe it's--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「P-Please don't go to any trouble.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. So that guidebook actually has some proper stuff written in it, huh?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eeeh, is it not usually proper?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte shows off some twisted knowledge from time to time.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「J-Jeez... Honestly, Lolotte...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「T-Thank you very much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go, make yourself comfortable. Now then, as for the cassette--」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, about the karaoke earlier. You made it sound like it was your very first time singing a song...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A-Ah... Well, it was my first time singing out loud with a voice and sounds that all of you could hear...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A-Aaah! No, that's not it, u-um... well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Like singing inside your head, something like that?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No... Apparently, our language is, well... very difficult for others to catch.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Just like how some languages don't pronounce the letter H, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's probably totally different from that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if I could hear it too? If you don't mind, let me listen.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Umm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Your voice was really pretty, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No, it wasn't...\s03」

name: Amyrina
message: 「O-Okay. I'll try.」
After Amyrina takes a slow, deep breath,
she silently moves her mouth.
A soundless melody beginning with a motion like humming.
Imagining it, it must surely be a very gentle, beautiful singing voice.
Unfortunately, however, I couldn't hear a thing.

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama. At times like this, try closing your eyes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
I do as I'm told. And then--
Ah...
I can hear it faintly.
A ray of light within the darkness. Amyrina's crystal-clear voice pierces straight through my mind.
The light soon parts the doors of darkness, and beyond where they open--
Ahh, how wonderful this feels.
Could this very thing be what is known as Angel's Bless?

name: Amyrina
message: 「Haa... that's all...」
I find myself applauding enthusiastically. The sensation was far too divine for me to put my impressions into words.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh... could it be, you heard my singing...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Just a little bit... though it might just be my imagination.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How could that be...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Could it be that you also have Ang--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hauuu!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. We really need to look for that cassette, don't we?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Phew... Still, singing out loud really does feel refreshing and wonderful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. I'm glad you made a nice discovery.」
Come to think of it, wasn't there someone close to me who also sang...

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... About the Holy Night Festival. Have you heard about it from Lolotte?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes, of course!」

name: Synn
message: 「Part of the program involves everyone singing a song together.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What...!」

name: Synn
message: 「For this Holy Night Festival, we're thinking of inviting the general public as guests too. So I'm sure you'll be invited either way, Amyrina, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're going to come anyway, why not join in and participate as a member of the choir?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「The... choir?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Let me go ask the choir leader real quick. Hang on a second!」

name: Misa
message: 「This had better be worth calling me all the way out here for.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Always measuring everything in terms of profit and loss. Classic hissy.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not a compliment!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Even I was surprised. I really wanted to let an expert hear her too.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph. If you're going that far, I'll make sure to listen closely.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「President... You really don't need to make such a big deal out of it...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. If you sing for us, Amyrina, I bet the Holy Night Festival will get even more exciting!」

name: Misa
message: 「You certainly think highly of her...」

name: Misa
message: 「Amyrina-san. As the choir, we are also widely recruiting people who would like to sing with us at the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't normally do things like this, but... Sakura-kun insisted that I hear you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Keeping this all to myself would be a waste.」

name: Misa
message: 「So it's not a test or anything like that. Don't be nervous, just sing freely.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y... yes! Understood.」
After taking yet another deep breath, she starts singing the song she had sung with Sacchin at karaoke.
A voice that resonates straight to the heart, even without a microphone.
A sense of pitch that lets her sing solidly, even without accompaniment.
Her vocal range is wide.
The sustain of her notes sounds pleasant to the ear, too.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hafuu...」
After finishing the song, Amyrina glances over repeatedly to gauge our reaction.
I clap.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lovely...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Right?!」

name: Misa
message: 「What a wonderful singing voice! Why have you kept this a secret until now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「She says she'd never sung before until this very day.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh... then that song was your first time today too...?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-yes... I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there's nothing to apologize for.\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「That song from just now. Could you try matching this melody for a second?」
Misa begins singing the lyrics of the same song at a different pitch.
Amyrina layers her voice in time with hers. When she does, it becomes a gorgeous mixed-voice chorus.

name: Misa
message: 「Not only is her sense of rhythm impeccable, she can even pull off harmonic singing perfectly...」

name: Misa
message: 「She's a prodigy!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even the great me can do that much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah. Then I'm looking forward to the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't answer a joke seriously.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, above all else, the clarity of her singing voice is just...\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Amyrina-san. It's not like this was a test, but you pass as our lead!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh, huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter what, I simply must have you sing together with everyone!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「T-Together with everyone...」

name: Synn
message: 「With the other choir members, in front of all the students?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. With practice, your voice is sure to become even lovelier. Then, as an example for everyone--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A-An example, no way! I-I could never do that...」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not true at all. I'm completely convinced of it.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But... I... even just singing in front of the people here is already so embarrassing...」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, my... What a waste.」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing it in front of everyone right from the start probably would make her nervous.」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, for regular practice, you really have to be a student.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if we couldn't work something out if we asked Helena-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we really shouldn't rely on the chairwoman for everything.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know...! Then how about doing regular practice at my house?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a brilliant idea.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's mostly empty rooms right now, and even if we make a bit of noise, it won't bother the neighbors.」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case... what do you say?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「O-Okay. I'll try.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! That sounds great!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, thanks to Amyrina-san, inspiration is just surging up inside me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be for the Christmas song?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes!! I'm going to go write it before I forget! Well then, Sakura-kun. Make sure you keep Amyrina-san hooked!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good tri~p.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Letting out a sigh like that. Could it be that you didn't like it?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-no! It's not that... um, well...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I only wish I could take the initiative and act on my own like Lolotte does...」

name: Synn
message: 「You practically did. After all, you sang in front of us, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, from now on, after school. Let's practice together at my house.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, with Lolotte too... alright!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-yes!」
